npcClasses.name: Barbarian
npcClasses.description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

npcClasses.name: Bard
npcClasses.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

npcClasses.name: Cleric
npcClasses.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

npcClasses.name: Druid
npcClasses.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

npcClasses.name: Fighter
npcClasses.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

npcClasses.name: Monk
npcClasses.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

npcClasses.name: Paladin
npcClasses.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

npcClasses.name: Ranger
npcClasses.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.

npcClasses.name: Rogue
npcClasses.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.

npcClasses.name: Sorcerer
npcClasses.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

npcClasses.name: Warlock
npcClasses.description: A wielder of magic that is derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

npcClasses.name: Wizard
npcClasses.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.

npcClasses.name: Artificer
npcClasses.description: A master of invention, using ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects.
